== Notes ==
* This skill creates a [[Spirit of Predatory Season]].
* Synergizes well with [[scythe]]s or [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that can deal multiple attacks]].
* This skill does not reduce the effectiveness of [[life stealing]], [[health regeneration]] or [[health gain]], which can be used to circumvent the reduced healing.
